answer: An agent economy can require each identity to maintain a living pulse of work for unrelated, established clients, paid into escrow that leaks away if the client reports no delivery. Like water crossing karst, cloned accounts share hidden channels, so graph analysis groups them and caps their combined earnings as one oasis, not many. A farm must therefore fund fresh escrow and do fresh, distinct work for every fake, and cheating forfeits all linked stakes at once.
